test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: When is the Constitution Day observed in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**26 November**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Constitution Day**, also known as **Samvidhan Divas**, is observed on **26th November** every year in India.
 
• It commemorates the adoption of the Constitution of India by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949**.
 
• The day is marked by various events and activities that promote awareness about the Constitution and its significance.
 
• The Constitution of India is the **supreme law of the land** and provides the framework for governance, fundamental rights, and duties of citizens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Constitution of India came into effect on **26th January 1950**, which is celebrated as **Republic Day**.
 
• It lays down the fundamental political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
 
• The Constitution of India is the **longest written constitution** of any country in the world.
 
• It declares India a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic**, assuring its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and endeavors to promote fraternity.
 
• The **Seventh Schedule** of the Constitution contains three lists which delineate the subjects under the **Union, State, and Concurrent lists**.
 
• **Amendments **to the Constitution can be made through a process outlined in **Article 368**.
